brief.zh: 照片里混进了细密的噪点。用<part-ref to="freq-filter"></part-ref>去掉它们，输出要和期望一样干净、柔和。
brief.en: Fine noise has crept into the photos. Remove it with <part-ref to="freq-filter"></part-ref>: the output must be as clean and soft as the expected image.

hint.zh: 离频谱中心 R 以内的频率留下，以外压掉。两种掩膜形状，哪种不起波纹？盯住误差图里边缘两侧出现的东西。
hint.en: Frequencies within R of the spectrum's centre stay, and the rest are pressed down. Of the two mask shapes, which makes no ripples? Watch what appears on both sides of the edges in the error map.

after.zh: 和<level-ref to="2-7"></level-ref>里一样：硬圆盘一刀切，等于用一个带负瓣的核做卷积，边缘两侧冒出一圈圈亮暗波纹（振铃）；高斯掩膜平滑过渡，对应的核还是高斯，没有波纹。期望图其实是 σ = 1 的空间高斯模糊，对应的掩膜宽度 R = N/(2πσ) = 32/(2π) ≈ 5。空间里卷积，等于频域里相乘，这就是卷积定理。
after.en: Just as in <level-ref to="2-7"></level-ref>: a hard disk cuts sharply, which is the same as a convolution with a kernel that has negative lobes, so rings of light and dark ripple out on both sides of an edge (ringing). A Gaussian mask falls off smoothly; its kernel is still a Gaussian, with no ripples. The expected image is in fact a spatial Gaussian blur with σ = 1, which matches a mask width of R = N/(2πσ) = 32/(2π) ≈ 5. Convolution in space equals multiplication in the frequency domain: this is the convolution theorem.

t.zh: 手机夜景、老照片的扫描件里，常有一层细密的噪点。颗粒越细，变化越快，在频谱上就离中心越远；图里大块的形状变化慢，落在中心附近。
t.en: Night shots on a phone and scans of old photos often have a layer of fine noise. The finer the grain, the faster it changes, and the farther from the centre it sits in the spectrum. Large shapes in the image change slowly and sit near the centre.

caption.en: Spectrum of the first test input

t.zh: <level-ref to="2-7"></level-ref>搭的东西现在是<part-ref to="freq-filter"></part-ref>元件：以中心为圆心留下一块频率。它有两个设置：掩膜形状（硬圆盘或高斯）和半径 R。<part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref>元件可以看任何结果的频谱。
t.en: What you built in <level-ref to="2-7"></level-ref> is now the <part-ref to="freq-filter"></part-ref> part: it keeps a disc of frequencies around the centre. It has two settings: the mask shape (hard disc or Gaussian) and the radius R. The <part-ref to="spectrum"></part-ref> part shows the spectrum of any result.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：去掉照片里的噪点，输出要和期望一样干净、柔和。四组测试是方块、圆盘、字母和横条，误差图会告诉你差在哪里。
t.en: In this level: remove the noise from the photos. The output must be as clean and soft as expected. The four test sets are a square, a disc, a letter and horizontal bars; the error map shows you where you are off.
